concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: tall asymmetric mineral silo, dark vertical clefts, lower single blue status lens, two upper-right cross-ribs and small energetic gold spiral. The concept has more fine fractures and a larger throat opening than source pixels establish; exact inner sections/wear remain authored, restrained in GLB.

glb_feedback.stage: Complete native/import geometry and seven-state pass.
discrepancies: Straight clefts give regular vase-like body rather than the wavy/asymmetric original.
Golden band flat and too uniform for source energetic ribbon.
corrections: Wavy cleft courses and a broader right foot; source-derived paired ribs seated against actual casing endpoints.
Authored continuous wisps in emissive gold map and physical wear chips.

glb_feedback.stage: Revised native render; independent import texture equality rejected a synthesized ORM variant, not a completed import pass.
glb_feedback.finding: Unlinking the gold metallic channel made glTF bake a second ORM image. All original images match, but that synthesized ninth image has no explicit native counterpart. Coarse inherited material regions also leave rectangular boundaries at the wavy cleft.
glb_feedback.correction: Author and pack explicit low-metallic energy ORM map, connect both PBR channels; assign cleft material after subdivision at actual coordinates and keep Boolean chips exposed.

final_review: Actual saved-native and independent GLB keep the tall flared mineral casing, wavy dark clefts, single low red/blue status port, two seated upper-right ribs and energetic gold spiral. Feedback replaces straight vase-like grooves with source-specific undulation/asymmetry, adds physical wear chips and continuous emissive wisps and explicit portable energy ORM. Seven actual animated states verify winding/disappearance and both colours of the same port.
limitations: Exact hidden sections, winding representation, energetic material and continuous timing are authored from limited original views.
A single skinned ribbon mesh uses96bones; tiny hidden pieces/alternate lens surface stow inside opaque footing. Colour swap is visibility encoding, not a claimed mechanical lamp motion.
Final user artistic acceptance, client state/scale/skin/shaders, satellite fit and Android performance remain separate.
